title: Den of the Rat
description: Odd blend of vanilla+ and fantasy mods. Intended to be an intermediate modded experience.
body:
Den of the Rat uses vanilla+ and fantasy mods to provide a basic modded experience.
- New biomes and world gen using Tectonic and Oh The Biomes You'll Go
- More weapons and fighting styles with Simply Swords and Better Combat
- Overhauls for nearly all vanilla generated structures
- New structures with Explorify and Dungeons and Taverns
- Nether and End overhauls, including  different types of eyes of ender from different structures around the world
- Storage and inventory mods like Colossal Chests, Sophisticated Backpacks, and Tom's Simple Storage Mod
- Waystones mod for fast movement around the world
- New mobs from Alex's Mobs and Mowzie's Mobs
- Built in shader support, with Complementary Unbound preinstalled
- The magic mod Mahou Tsukai, allowing players to wield powerful spells
- Apotheosis, adding specialized gear and stat modificiations, as well as enchantment table tweaks
- A variety of farming mods built around Farmer's Delight
